text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for prod-inference-eu1 - embeddings-service 5xx spike (alert_id=I-310000)
pagerduty: PagerDuty alert: prod-inference-eu1 / embeddings-service — triggered by 5xx rate > 8% over 2m. Play: inference-prod. PagerDuty link: https://pd.example/incidents/I-310000
sara-oncall: ACK @pagerduty taking it. I’m on the bridge: https://meet.example/bridges/310000-embeds
jamal-sre: thx sara. quick Q: is this across all zones or eu1-only?
sara-oncall: looks eu1 only based on initial metrics. rolling 5xxs and latency up ~3x. customers seeing failed embedding calls. I’ll post query.
sara-oncall: ```
# quick kql
sum(rate(http_responses{service="embeddings",region="eu1",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (status)
```
derek-infra: seeing kernel OOMs on a couple of nodes in the eu1-gpu-pool around the time of spike. Autoscaler attempted scale but hit quota for GPU cores in the AZ.
ops-bot: autoscaler: attempted scale +4 nodes in eu1-gpu-pool at 2026-03-14T22:00:12Z -> quotaExceeded
jamal-sre: if quota blocked scaling, fallback routing would help — can we route embeddings traffic to eu2 or to cpu-fallback? what’s the compatibility matrix for the model variant?
sara-oncall: we have smaller fp16 quantized variant on eu2 but slightly lower throughput. I can toggle routing to eu2 for non-low-latency SLAs. doing a small canary reroute for 10% now.
sara-oncall: /run cmd: redwood route update --service embeddings --from-region eu1 --to-region eu2 --percent 10
sara-oncall: canaries showing success for rerouted requests. 10% -> eu2 OK, 5xx down for those.
jamal-sre: good. can you bump to 40% and watch error-rate delta? also open a quota request with cloud team asap.
sara-oncall: bumping to 40% -> /run cmd: redwood route update --percent 40
sara-oncall: logs: ```
2026-03-14T22:04:21Z request_id=abc123 status=200 latency_ms=132 region=eu2
2026-03-14T22:04:26Z request_id=abc124 status=200 latency_ms=145 region=eu2
```
derek-infra: i’ve put in a manual quota increase request (case #QC-8792) and also started /drain on two problematic nodes to evict stuck containers. will update.
ops-bot: node-drain: node eu1-gpu-07 drain started by derek-infra
sara-oncall: traffic routed 40% eu2. overall 5xx rate in eu1 dropped from 9.6% -> 3.1% immediately. customer-facing error reports reduced too. still monitoring.
jamal-sre: good stabilization. what customer impact do we have? any enterprise customers affected with SLAs?
sara-oncall: early census: three customers saw elevated error rates (IDs C-231, C-998, C-412). C-231 is high priority (enterprise). I DM’d success for C-231 support and opened a support ticket summarizing mitigation.
kevin-nightlead: I’m riding up to take handoff in 30m. if still active, hand me ownership. otherwise self-resolve and create follow-up incident for quota/root cause.
sara-oncall: noted. handing off to @kevin-nightlead in 30m unless we need deeper infra actions. current bridge link and notes pinned.
sara-oncall: pinned notes: routing to eu2 canary 40%, autoscaler blocked by quota, OOMs on two nodes, manual drain started, customer tickets opened.
jamal-sre: assign follow-ups: 1) cloud quota increase + retrospective with cloud team (derek-infra) 2) look at model memory growth pattern and KV cache behavior (platform team) 3) add a synthetic test that simulates long streaming embeddings loads (sre/devex).
derek-infra: quota approved temporarily for +6 GPUs in eu1; autoscaler resumed and new nodes provisioning now.
ops-bot: autoscaler: scaled +6 nodes in eu1-gpu-pool at 2026-03-14T22:24:03Z -> success
sara-oncall: eu1 5xx rate now 0.7% and latency trending down to baseline. starting to shift traffic back. switching route to 10% eu2 as safety.
sara-oncall: /run cmd: redwood route update --percent 10
kevin-nightlead: I’ve joined bridge and verified metrics. setting ownership to me for follow-up; sara you can sign out. I’ll coordinate postmortem and customer comms.
kevin-nightlead: ACK taking ownership. ETA for full return to normal: 20m, then close. Will open incident doc and post follow-up timeline.
incident-bot: Incident I-310000 status: acknowledged -> resolved by kevin-nightlead at 2026-03-14T22:40:05Z (note: monitoring showed steady baseline for 10m). Postmortem doc: https://docs.example/incidents/I-310000
sara-oncall: resolved for on-call, thanks team :tada: — I’ll add the playbook note about needing a hard quota alert earlier.
jamal-sre: nice work. follow-up items captured. moving to review in retro next week.
kevin-nightlead: closing thread in ~1h after I finish the incident doc. if anyone sees regressions ping me directly.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident I-310000 resolved. Summary: autoscaler blocked by quota -> node OOMs -> partial routing to eu2 mitigated customer impact. Follow-up: quota hard alert, model memory review, synthetic load test.
